meta.scope: Refresh two existing relevance-4 GitHub repository records supplied by the author

records.title: DoomFly: fly-connectome simulation controlling a Doom arena
Embodied Whole-Brain Spiking Simulation of Drosophila (claude-fly)

updates.модальность: Connectome-derived neural activity and simulated visual input
updates.задача: Closed-loop game control with engineered aversive reinforcement
updates.метод: MaleCNS v1.0 graph simulation and ViZDoom
updates.кросс_субъект: Not applicable; no biological population validation
updates.ограничения: Experimental engineering model; current candidate failed visual, conditioning and survival gates; artificial dopamine input is not subjective pain

claims.claim: DoomFly is an open closed-loop MaleCNS/ViZDoom engineering experiment with explicit negative validation results.
claims.evidence: Repository README and live-training protocol at commit 71ecf53d78eaffaf1a57ed7b0ccf5d458abc9f33
claims.limitation: Artificial sensory, controller and dopamine interfaces; failed gates; no biological pain or learning validation.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use as a reproducible engineering comparator, not evidence of pain, nociception or learned survival.

decisions.notes: Repository and explicit negative validation results confirmed. Passing software tests is not biological validation.

updates.название: Emergent Individuality in Whole-Brain Connectome Simulations of Drosophila melanogaster (claude-fly)
updates.модальность: Connectome-derived neural activity, movement and simulated sensory input
updates.метод: FlyWire v783, LIF dynamics, NeuroMechFly v2 and MuJoCo
updates.кросс_субъект: Two simulated agents are described; no biological cross-subject validation
updates.ограничения: Repository claims and included outputs were not independently reproduced; README DOI was not resolvable during review and clone instructions reference another repository

evidence.population: two simulated adult agents described by the repository

claims.claim: The supplied claude-fly repository exists and describes an embodied FlyWire/NeuroMechFly simulation with two synthetic agents.
claims.evidence: Repository README and files at commit 3a035275148e97539711728422548bffe2a77566
claims.limitation: Quantitative results were not reproduced; claimed Zenodo DOI did not resolve during review; clone instructions reference another repository.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use only as a partially verified simulation candidate requiring independent reproduction.

decisions.notes: Repository identity and README confirmed, reversing the earlier unverifiable decision. Scientific claims remain only partially verified.
